summary: Unnamed man in his mid-30s fell off his innertube during a private tubing trip on the Arkansas River east of Portland and drowned; a bystander fisherman pulled him ashore and began CPR; Florence EMS, Fremont County Sheriff's Office, the Fremont County Coroner and CPW AHRA rangers responded; pronounced dead at the scene; no personal flotation device observed.
responding_agency: Fremont County Sheriff's Office; Florence EMS; Fremont County Coroner; CPW Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area rangers
notes: CPW AHRA release published 2024-07-15 (incident 'died Saturday'). Victim unnamed in source pending family notification. Run 1017 chunk A.
